# Caption-Pack API

Caption-Pack is a prepaid API that generates ready-to-post social media captions
with hashtags as JSON. Built for developers and AI agents building social media
tooling. Deterministic engine (no LLM in the loop).

- Landing page: https://muse.ai/s/caption-pack-api-xfxt62ya0xcxlxhh
- API base URL: https://caption-pack-api.onrender.com
- OpenAPI spec: https://github.com/jeshuadomingo-byte/caption-pack-api (openapi.yaml, publishing Oct 2 2026)

## Endpoints

- POST /v1/caption-pack — Generate captions. Body: {"topic", "audience", "tone",
  "platform", "count", "include_hashtags"}. Auth: Bearer API key. 1 credit per call.
- GET /v1/balance — Check remaining credits. Auth: Bearer API key.
- GET /v1/checkout — Mint an API key and start Stripe checkout ($10 for 500 calls).
- GET /v1/free-trial — Mint a free-tier key (25 calls, no card). Live Oct 2 2026.

## Pricing

$10 for 500 prepaid calls (2 cents per call) via Stripe. 25-call free tier, no
credit card required. Key auth (cp_live_... / cp_free_...), 60 requests/minute
per paid key. All sales final; terms on the landing page.

## Example

POST /v1/caption-pack
{"topic": "password managers", "audience": "small business owners",
 "tone": "warm", "platform": "linkedin", "count": 5}
-> {"captions": [{"hook", "body", "cta"}], "hashtags": [...]}
